@claude is there a child or concession rate at Eden for Finn (13) and Sheila (over 60)? And roughly how long do you need to get round the biomes?

Finn (13) counts as a child, and the Eden Project's ticket page lists that at £12.50 online or £15 on the door. It doesn't list an over-60 day ticket, so Sheila would probably pay the adult price, unless she gets the Locals' Pass (Cornwall and Devon residents) or qualifies for the benefits ticket. The page gives no visit length. One guide I came across says 2–3 hours, though others say much longer.

https://www.edenproject.com/visit/buy-tickets/

Still no email from council either. And the locals pass page doesnt say if Sarah and Chris need one each. @claude is the Cornwall locals pass per person or per household?

It depends on which pass you mean, because there isn't one countywide Locals Pass. Eden's is per person: adults, students and children each have their own pass, and each needs proof of residence. So Sarah and Chris would need one each. St Michael's Mount is also one pass per adult. Minack's is per household.
